clues.value: 101-year-old ▇▇▇ tells the story of her life aboard the ▇▇▇, 84 years later. A young ▇▇▇ boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, ▇▇▇ and ▇▇▇ De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. ▇▇▇ tells the whole story from ▇▇▇'s departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.
